meta.title: Jio IPO Historic Listing: 21% Premium Analysis

scenes.headline: *JIO* CREATES HISTORY
scenes.subtitle: Listing Day: ₹1119 Share Jumped to ₹1359!
scenes.voice: Jio ka IPO list ho gaya aur isne history create kar di! 1119 ka share seedha 1359 par khula, matlab seedha 21 percent profit!

scenes.headline: *30,000 CR* IPO
scenes.label: Institutional Subscription
scenes.voice: Ye India ka sabse bada 30 hazar crore ka IPO tha. Retailers ne dhai guna bhara, par Institutions ne 70 times!

scenes.headline: INDIA'S *BIGGEST*
scenes.voice: Listing ke sath hi Jio officially India ki sabse badi telecom company ban chuki hai. Analysts ka 1350 ka target pehle din hi hit ho gaya!

scenes.headline: TRACK *SMART MONEY*
scenes.voice: Pro tip: QIB data yani smart money ka flow track karne ke liye NSE ki official API ya Python scrapers use karo, taaki retail FOMO se bach sako.

scenes.headline: DATA DRIVEN *INVESTING*
scenes.voice: Aise hi data-driven market hacks ke liye techwith.GenZ ko abhi follow kar lo!
